name: Example: Computing a Probability on a Bounded Interval
worked_solution:
If $X$ follows a discrete uniform distribution over a set $S,$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14268989/assets/830df36f7ea0a89f13fcb1f11f7f5b787fb9d099fd10b019ba0172168f279772.svg)

Here, we have $X \sim U \left\lbrace 7, 8, 9, \ldots, 16 \right\rbrace,$ and the set $S = \left\lbrace 7, 8, 9, \ldots, 16 \right\rbrace$ has $|S|=16 - 7 + 1 = 10$ items. So, we have

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14268989/assets/2002f51379a57bd014409bed9fb7c3153a6c8047305e51894371bd9d63b9b32b.svg)

In $S,$ there are $5$ items $(8, 9, 10, 11, 12)$ that satisfy $8 \leq  X < 13.$ Therefore,

$$
P(8 \leq  X < 13) = 5 \cdot \dfrac{1}{10} = \dfrac{1}{2}.
$$
